# Runs: invented users, in a real browser, in real Claude.

> Runs of browser agents playing invented users on customers.riskmandate.ai, in real Claude: each replayed step by step from its screenshots, with its findings checked and what we changed. Plus the brief to run one, and the personas.

*Source: <https://customers.riskmandate.ai/feedback/runs/> · site v0.2.5 (2026-10-21) · this file is generated from the same content as the page, so the two cannot drift. Every page on this site has a `.md` twin; internal links below point at them.*

---

An agent plays one invented person, drives a real browser on the live site, tries every example in real Claude, and sends back its screenshots, its report and a record of every step. Each run is replayed here, step by step, with what we found and what we changed.

**Invented users, real runs.** The people are invented and a model plays them; the browser, the site and the assistant's answers are real. This is not user research.
